extra.transit_stops_vintage: gtfs-mbta is not this region's feed and there is no ozarks row to prefer over it. PostGISLayerStore.vintage() selects the most recent meta.layer_vintage row for the schema without knowing which region asked, and no GTFS feed has ever been loaded for the Ozarks because no agency publishes one. The layer froze 0 features, so nothing in this route reads a stop that came from Boston - but the pin is a statement about a feed this corridor does not have, and it is left as the freeze wrote it rather than hand-corrected. See the route README.
extra.canopy: not fetched. The DSM over Mark Twain National Forest is terrain plus canopy and that arithmetic has never met a real forest, but the canopy raster is a separate national fetch this build has not made for any region - so its absence here is the same absence every other golden carries, not a choice about this one.
